use: Complete uniquely owned private compiled-C manager, same-file state/asset/printer helpers, and mixer reset. No original generated C, SDK bodies/layout, assets or ROM payload is redistributed. This is source ownership evidence, not native runtime qualification.

retained_source_behavior.raw_routes: All original raw routes0 through24 remain in the complete original switch; original7/10/16 bodies remain no-ops, not synthetic scene entries.
retained_source_behavior.nested_menu: Title receives raw8; only its real raw0 result immediately enters Name with raw0, before latch clearing. The manager routes the actual Name result, including Oaks Lab, without a host-side switch.
retained_source_behavior.attract: Retain D_800AC010 across all scene lifetimes; Source sets latch1, selects Beach/Tunnel from old value, then updates modulo2.
retained_source_behavior.per_loop: Source calls gtlSetIntervals(1,1) then clears the canonical idle pointer at every original loop iteration.
retained_source_behavior.gallery: Source22 performs AAF20 reset before falling through to Gallery;23 omits reset;24 loads its distinct end-level overlay and omits reset.
retained_source_behavior.boot_settings: Custom reverb, complete AAF20 reset, more_funcs overlay, intro overlay, intro VPK, actual Boot completion, full printer test/diagnostic behavior, saved sound quality and canonical saved offsets precede raw8 selection.

native_backend_contract.implementation: application_manager.cpp supplies the concrete returning services over canonical State, admitted Snapshot/Catalog residency, Input, Audio and GtlClock. Its independent original-C continuation publishes typed entry intents; actual native scenes remain host-owned and unsupported operations cannot complete successfully.
native_backend_contract.source_entry_owner: An independent application continuation/domain and its plain-C Source/context survive every sceneStorage reset, native scene retirement, graphics/photo/RSP/RDP/readback and PCM fence.
native_backend_contract.request_only: native_request_entry publishes operation/argument and returns. It does not call Source, construct or tick a scene. application_enter performs a positive wait in C only after that leaf has returned.
native_backend_contract.outside_completion: Host consumes intent only after manager resume returns; creates/drives/retires the real scene outside callbacks; supplies actual signed Source result once through native_entry_result. Zero remains a real result, not a default routing alias.
native_backend_contract.cancellation_failure: Use the existing continuation wait/cancel/join/fail contract. Cancellation never returns to discarded C state. Checked native failures retain the first IsleGameResult and terminate through isle_continuation_fail after all native leaves have returned.
native_backend_contract.state_migration: Embed exactly one IsleApplicationManagerState in existing game::State; migrate/remove its existing scene_latch_ and idle_script_ storage. Never mirror latch or attract state. Idle uses the existing const IslePlayerIdleScript pointer type verbatim. Menu entry_flags/scene notice masks remain separate from the scene-manager latch.
native_backend_contract.save_reuse: native_saved_offsets calls existing canonical GameSnapshot::screen_offsets; the 5BF20 getter is provenance only and is not separately materialized. native_check_flag and set_level reuse canonical State/save storage.
native_backend_contract.mixer_cutover: Remove the old C++ startup_runtime.cpp reset_mixer algorithm from the integrated manager path; all manager-owned reset ordering now executes the complete private568D0.c16–28 body.
native_backend_contract.resources: Overlay/ROM/VPK enum values are typed identity tokens only. Resolve their exact original source segments through real resource/catalog owners, never SDK overlays or guest memory/function pointers.
native_backend_contract.printer: Availability is a real native capability fact. When present, supply a retained writable4MiB native allocation; original exclusive memory loop touches exactly0xffffc words and uses real writeback/invalidate services over0x400000 bytes. PANIC remains an execution failure; diagnostic entries require real outside-owner completion.
native_backend_contract.frame: Each independently reserved course uses a new cold Frame; never reuse a dispatched Boot/Title Frame for Beach reserve.

integration.compile: Compile src/application_source.c as C, adding the private materialization directory to its private include path; do not compile application_original.inc separately.
integration.link: Existing native engine/public types and continuation C ABI plus the parent real application-native leaf implementation; no sceneStorage-owned manager object.
integration.verification: Not run: no materializer execution, compilation, build, tests, lint, formatter or runtime checks in this slice. Parent validates once after writers release.
